_about: Frozen on 27 Oct 2026, before any alternative was run. Each variant changes ONE baseline rule in configs/planning_slice_parameters.json (the baseline stays unchanged). Every variant is reported; none is preferred. The unit screen is not varied, so all variants select within Mysuru.

variants.why: Charger spacing: half the S33 1 km grid side (a looser duplication screen)
Charger spacing: twice the S33 1 km grid side (a stricter duplication screen)
Town eligibility: tighter urban proxy (2 km from a city or town node)
Town eligibility: looser urban proxy (5 km)
Town eligibility: place=city nodes only (larger urban areas)
Budget handling: a ceiling below the baseline spend (INR 25 lakh), so the budget binds
Budget handling: drop the one-site-per-settlement cap, so the INR 50 lakh ceiling can bind
